title: Acme renewal risk review
transcript:
Dana: Okonkwo's CTO said it plainly — another incident like July and they walk at renewal. They are already talking to a competitor.
Lee: The July peak was the stream-stall bug. Okonkwo filed the tracker issue on it himself. The fix is staged; it ships Thursday.
Dana: Then Thursday matters more than any discount. I have authority up to eighteen percent but I'd rather not open that door.
Marcus: Agreed, hold the discount. Let's regroup after Thursday's release and see where their CTO stands.
Dana: One more thing from the call — when their agent pulls a PDF through the retrieval tool, the attachment silently disappears from the result. No error, the answer just quietly ignores it. Okonkwo says nobody has filed it.
Lee: First I'm hearing of it. That needs a tracker issue.
Dana: Their billing is spotless, for the record. 1039 paid on time again.
